== Summary ==
Slip “•Patience!” cut unchanged from page 8 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 840, 1624, 1563)). Version [[Patience!]] (Original). Not a recreation.
